overview: TradeNest Naturals offers Ashwagandha Powder for B2B buyers seeking a reliable bulk ingredient from India. The powder is fine milled to 80-100 mesh for easy blending in dry formulations and liquid mixes. It is produced under FSSAI-registered operations and supplied by an IEC-registered exporter for domestic and international trade needs.

The material is processed through a controlled 6-step flow: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. Available in bulk supply with MOQ 5 Kg, it suits manufacturers, brands, and distributors. OEM and private label support are available, along with custom mesh and packaging on request.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: The MOQ is 5 Kg for this product.

faqs.q: Can you supply OEM or private-label orders?
faqs.a: Yes. OEM and private label supply are available on request.
The standard mesh size is 80-100 mesh. Custom mesh can be arranged on request.

faqs.q: What packaging options do you offer?
faqs.a: We offer 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches and jars.
